limitations: Nine new physical sources were reviewed in three separate admitted groups: ARR, monthly group and monthly distribution. Source-row observations are not unique customers, charges, monthly billing items or incidents. No source namespace is merged or deduplicated.

Every source row and repeated occurrence remains in the private census. Distinct typed whole-record versions and repeated occurrences are source-local diagnostics. Equal records, row counts or model names do not establish duplicate charges or transformation lineage.

All 53 declared fields have all-row presence partitions, including absence. Additional unknown top-level fields contribute source-local aggregate field and field-row counts only. Their names, hashes and values are excluded, and unknown fields are not matched across namespaces.

Identifier and month-literal cardinalities are exploratory source-and-field-qualified hash counts. Only strict unpadded nonempty strings without control characters enter them; other types and states remain explicit exclusions. Repeated candidate pairs are preserved and no primary key is assumed.

Month syntax categories do not define effective dates or monthly grain. Literal month strings are not normalized; valid YYYY-MM, calendar-valid YYYY-MM-DD and other nonempty strings remain distinct syntax categories. Timestamp syntax is not historical ownership.

Names, regions, emails, descriptions, billing labels, financial labels and package/invoice values are presence/type only. Monetary fields add fixed syntax categories without amounts, totals, ranges, distributions, currency interpretation or calculated ARR.

Typed whole-record hashing preserves exact integer and fractional values, scalar JSON type distinctions and signed zero. Decimal normalization is context independent. Numeric strings remain strings. JSON whitespace and object order affect raw-line hashes but not typed record versions.

Source identifiers, per-record and field-name hashes, raw names, amounts, text, URLs, paths and credentials are excluded from this artifact. There is no native-resource or account/tenant join, geography inheritance, billing-role attribution, customer-status determination or incident-impact claim.
